stem:
Priya fries puris at home to test whether the oil is hot enough. She changes only the amount of oil she adds to the pan each time.

She wants evidence she can compare across her trials.

Which row describes what Priya should observe or measure as evidence?

options.text: observation: whether the puri puffed up; measurement: none needed; notes: written from memory after cooking
observation: whether the puri puffed up; measurement: amount of oil added each time; notes: written during the experiment
observation: none, puffing is only yes/no so it cannot be evidence; measurement: amount of oil added; notes: written during the experiment
observation: whether smoke or splatter was seen; measurement: none needed; notes: written from memory after cooking

tables: {"headers":["what to observe","what to measure","how to keep notes"],"rows":[["whether the puri puffed up","none needed","from memory after cooking"],["whether the puri puffed up","amount of oil added each time","during the experiment"],["none; puffing is only yes/no","amount of oil added each time","during the experiment"],["smoke or splatter only","none needed","from memory after cooking"]],"row_labels":["A","B","C","D"],"caption":"","is_option_table":true}

teacher.key_rationale: Evidence must include both an observable result (whether the puri puffed, a valid yes/no observation) and the measured variable (amount of oil), with notes recorded during the experiment rather than reconstructed from memory. Only row B satisfies all three conditions; A drops the measurement and relies on memory, C wrongly rejects yes/no observations as evidence, D drops the measurement and uses memory notes.
